nom: Avène Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Face and Body Lotion

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin generally describe the lotion as greasy, pore-clogging and prone to causing breakouts and bumps, though one reports it cured hormonal acne and scars.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: several find it moisturizing and soothing for winter dryness or eczema, while others still find it too greasy or heavy for daily wear.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often report no irritation, no burning and good tolerance even under heavy sun exposure, though a few describe smell-related discomfort or an allergic reaction with sweat and heat.
segments.combination: One combination-skin reviewer manages the oily T-zone shine with a finishing powder while otherwise liking the product for daily face and body use.
segments.mature: An older reviewer with aging skin on the arms uses it as a daily moisturizing sunscreen without complaint.

concerns.aging: One mature-skin reviewer uses it successfully as an everyday moisturizing sunscreen; no anti-aging effect is specifically claimed.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers with dry skin call it strongly moisturizing and helpful for winter dryness or eczema-prone skin, while one dry-skin reviewer still found it too greasy despite the hydration.
concerns.redness: Sensitive and reactive-skin reviewers largely report no irritation or rash even after prolonged heavy sun exposure, but one reviewer describes an allergic reaction when sweating in heat and another notes possible irritation from a leaking bottle.
concerns.barrier: Eczema-prone reviewers describe it as soothing and non-irritating, useful during flare-ups or winter dryness, with no barrier-related complaints reported.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with hyperpigmentation prefers a tinted mineral sunscreen for the face instead of this product, implying it does not address discoloration.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: one acne-prone reviewer credits it with clearing hormonal breakouts and scars, while another with oily acne-prone skin says it clogged pores and caused new breakouts and bumps.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers overwhelmingly describe the formula as greasy, heavy and slow to absorb, often requiring blotting or powder to control shine.

extraits.texte: I have very oily acne prone skin so finding a sunscreen that is comfortable and effective at protection is difficult. This sunscreen is horrible. It's extremely greasy to the point where I look like I'm sweating and because it doesn't dry down, my skin is sticky and my hair will stick onto areas like the sides of the face and neck (think of hair getting stuck on goopy lipgloss). Despite being a runny lotion, I find the formula very heavy on the skin to the point where it clogged my pores leading to breakouts and bumps throughout my face. Be careful when applying/reapplying this around your neck as it will leave a white sticky residue on the collar of your shirt although it does come off when washing. No yellow or brown stains were left behind on my clothes though. I have horizontal neck lines and throughout the day product would settle into them so I have to constantly be blending my neck; this also applies to my eyelids making it look like I have two white lines. Reapplication feels like adding a heavy greasy layer on the skin again, something that I did not enjoy doing even though I blotted away excess oils and product before reapplying. On the positive side, this sunscreen despite being a mineral formula, doesn't leave a clownish white cast on my medium skin tone. I use two fingers length of product (one for face, one for neck). I used this new mineral sunscreen for about a month - daily - and had been enjoying it. No white cast, dewy complexion, moisturizing feel. Then this past week the Northeast was hit with a heatwave. During 90+ degree temps, I was sweating quite a bit. I unfortunately discovered that for some reason, my sweat and this sunscreen don't seem to mix and I was having an allergic reaction. So, I had to suspend my use. I'll resume using it when the temperature drops below 70 degrees just to finish up the tube. I really like it, but since I can't wear it during peak heat without having a reaction, it doesn't make sense to repurchase. I need something that can be worn all year round.

extraits.titre: the BEST. great for acne prone skin and scars.
extraits.texte: have tried so many different face sunscreens. this is the BEST. and has pretty much cured my hormonal acne breakouts and scars. seriously. i'm so grateful. please keep making this.

I love this! For a completely mineral sunscreen with no tint, I'm super impressed. This is a great moisturizer and can totally be used as a single step. It does have a waxy sort of smell to it when you first apply but it doesn't linger- if you're someone who has to use all fragrance-free products because of eczema you probably already know exactly whatp I'm talking about. But again, the smell doesn't linger, it completely disappears. There is also a pretty strong white cast when you first apply, but after rubbing it in well and waiting for it to absorb (you should be waiting ~20 mins after applying sunscreen before you go outside anyway!) it completely disappears on my brown skin. (I'm about the skin tone of Parveen Kaur for reference lol.) I only use it on my body though, for two reasons: 1) I prefer tinted minerals on my face to help with hyperpigmentation, and 2) white casts are always more noticeable on the face in my opinion. But if I try it on my face I will report back! Overall, I find this super moisturizing and great for winter dryness and/or eczema prone skin. I like to apply it on my arms and legs, even in the winter when I'm covered up. Feels thick and soothing and leaves my skin soft. If you like a lightweight sunscreen that doesn't feel like body lotion, this is NOT for you. Especially in a humid climate, this might be too much. extraits.titre: Flawless performance -- an absolute winner for sun-sensit...
extraits.texte: I recently returned from a field mission to multiple sub-Saharan countries. I applied this sunscreen several times a day on every inch of my skin that might be exposed to the sun, including my whole face and around my eyes. After 9 weeks in the field, my highly sensitive skin showed absolutely no signs of sunburn, irritation or dryness. Furthermore, its mineral formula is not harmful to the environment, which is also very important to me. Perfect!! I do use the Mineral Multi Defense Fluid on my face when I'm back at home as it seems to work better under my make-up, and continue to use the Face & Body Lotion everywhere else. NOTE TO AVENE: Please, please, make a lighter shade of the Tinted Compact. The lightest shade currently available (Beige) is still too dark for me and everyone else in my family. I've noticed that several other customers are requesting it too!!

My go-to when I need the most serious protection! This keeps my pale, dry, and delicate skin safe in the most intense Sun locations like the tropics, snorkeling, surfing, and sailing. It is very moisturizing, which I love. It applies slightly pale, then quickly disappears so my skin tone looks normal and glowing.
I use this on my face when I plan to wear a mineral powder foundation as it is a bit on the oily side. But it is great as a daily sunscreen and moisturizer on my old arms in Texas sun.
